title: Spectral Edge × shadcn
question: One visual direction, three layouts. Choose what to carry forward, or describe a combination. All previews are illustrative; implementation will use verified backend fields.

options.label: Spectral Overview
options.thesis: A calm overview of health, attention, and research.
options.viewport: Slim sidebar, compact health row, attention beside qualification, evidence below.
options.risk: Broadest overview; detailed investigation opens a second view.

options.label: Spectral Attention
options.thesis: Start with the exception, then inspect its evidence beside it.
options.viewport: Attention queue and persistent inspector, with a research register underneath.
options.risk: Best for daily triage; research has a supporting role.

options.label: Spectral Research
options.thesis: Browse research cycles with their evidence always in view.
options.viewport: Health strip, spacious cycle table, and a right-hand evidence inspector.
options.risk: Strongest research workspace; less room for the full exception list.
